findings.issue: Production build artifacts (dist/, server/, including Qwik's minified runtime q-BzUpVKqY.js) are committed to the repo, which is why static analysis surfaces framework-internal strings (QRL docs link, undici/node:stream/web imports) as if they were app code
findings.suggestion: Add dist/ and server/ to .gitignore; only the hand-written src/ and adapters/ belong in version control

findings.issue: createQwikCity and the @builder.io package names are already renamed in Qwik v2 (@qwik.dev/router, createQwikRouter), which is at 2.0.0-rc.3; the v1 line the app pins will eventually need a mechanical migration
findings.suggestion: Stay on stable 1.x (correct choice now) and run `qwik migrate-v2` when v2 goes stable; the entry file's 1:1 match with the official starter keeps that cheap

summary: This app contains zero experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs: every Qwik/Qwik City feature used (component$, useSignal, routeLoader$, status(404), createQwikCity, renderToStream) has been stable for years, and it pins the exact current stable release 1.20.3. The only 'experimental' signal from static analysis is a QRL error string inside Qwik's own committed build bundle, not app code. Main follow-up is repo hygiene: stop committing dist/ and server/ build output.
